name: pointer-accent
title: PointerAccent
description: Optional GSAP pointer follower. Native cursor stays visible. Disabled on touch, coarse pointers, and reduced motion. Not a custom cursor.

  settle: "cds-settle",
  move: "cds-move",
  exit: "cds-exit",
  linear: "cds-linear",
